cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Keep the treasurer's page out of the fair briefing. Our chair needs everyone's confidence today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She spent the stall money on that arch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Call it donated decoration. If the stallholders find out, they'll replace her before we open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover the shortfall, but she must sign an IOU.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Privately, after her welcome. Let them see her opening the fair, not borrowing to open it.

mechanism: A uses professional briefing and financial-document sequencing to conceal a chair spending failure and preserve her authority through the fair opening.
confusable: D61 would conceal A caused a problem; here A protects someone else position because public confidence sustains the current balance.
comparison: Launch alternative masks a vacancy and equalises rivals; fair alternative keeps debt private while preserving the chair public welcome.
seedUse: Fair stall funds, arch, treasurer page and private IOU derive from D63-b; S03 adds exact document and timing corrections.
